description:
BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com .

This role will require being full-time onsite at our Palo Alto office to support collaborative team dynamics and innovative problem-solving.

Crypto is becoming real financial infrastructure and BitGo has spent more than a decade building the products making that transition possible. Since 2013, we’ve built infrastructure that institutions use to custody, trade, stake, settle, and move digital assets. We’ve operated through every market cycle, expanded around the world, earned the trust of thousands of institutions, and become a publicly traded company along the way.

And we’re still early.

We’re hiring a Product Marketing Manager to help define what comes next: how new products enter the market, how clients understand them, how Sales sells them, and ultimately how BitGo tells its story as digital assets become part of mainstream finance.

This is a role for someone who wants ownership. We’re building at the center of a financial system that is changing in real time, and no two days look the same. You’ll work with the smartest people in the industry to turn complex products and ambitious ideas into simple, compelling stories and bring them to market.

This role is full-time onsite at one of our BitGo hubs. We believe the best GTM work happens when you’re in the room with Product, Sales, and other stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

• Positioning and messaging: Figure out what makes our products matter and develop positioning that is differentiated, memorable, and useful, from the one-sentence pitch to the full product narrative.

• GTM strategy and launches: Own launches alongside Product from idea to adoption. Define the audience and narrative, build the GTM strategy, align teams around it, bring products to market, and keep pushing after launch.

• Competitive and market intelligence: Understand competitors, market structure, client needs, and emerging trends, then turn that intelligence into sharper positioning, better product decisions, and new commercial opportunities.

• Sales enablement: Give Sales the stories and tools they need to win, and turn insights from the field into sharper positioning and GTM.

• Cross-functional leadership: Be the connective tissue between Product, Sales, Marketing, Design, and other teams. Some of the most important opportunities won’t arrive with a perfectly written brief. You’ll turn ambiguity into strategy and strategy into action.

• The BitGo narrative: Help define how BitGo shows up in the world. Partner across Content, Growth, PR, and IR to tell the story of a public company operating at the center of a rapidly changing financial system.

Non-negotiables:

We care more about what you’ve done and how you think than checking every box. But you’ll probably thrive here if you have:

• 4–7 years of product marketing or closely related experience , with meaningful launches you’ve personally driven from strategy through execution, not just supported.

• Exceptional positioning instinct s. You can find the simplest, sharpest articulation of why a complicated product matters now.

• A commercial mindset. You care about adoption, revenue, clients, and winning, not just shipping marketing assets.

• High agency. When something is unclear, you investigate. When something is missing, you build it. When something could be better, you say so.

• The ability to cross organizational boundaries and get people moving , even when you don’t formally own the teams involved.

• An AI-forward approach . You already use AI to research, think, write, analyze, and work faster, and you want to push that even further.

• Comfort operating in ambiguity and moving quickly without sacrificing judgment.

• Excellent writing and storytelling skills , with the ability to turn technical products and complex ideas into narratives people immediately understand.

Experience in crypto, fintech, financial services, banking, or high-growth technology is helpful, but not required. Curiosity about how money and markets are changing is.

Why Join BitGo?

There aren't many opportunities to join a company with more than a decade of history that still feels like it's entering its most important chapter.

BitGo is publicly traded, federally chartered, and operates around the world. Our infrastructure sits behind institutions building in digital assets today, and the market we serve is expanding as crypto, stablecoins, tokenization, and traditional financial markets increasingly converge.

That creates an unusual PMM challenge: established company, emerging category, sophisticated customers, complex products, and a lot of white space still left to define. If you want your GTM work to matter at scale and help lead the tradition to the digital asset economy, this is the place to be.

Benefits

• Competitive base salary, bonus, and stock options

• 100% company-paid health insurance for employee, partner, and dependents

• Up to 4% 401k company match

• Paid parental leave, Paid vacation

• Free commuter/parking pass

• Free custom lunches, dinners, and snacks

• Computer equipment and workplace furniture to suit your needs

• Great colleagues and an inspiring startup environment

Benefits may vary based on location.

Pay Transparency Notice:

Depending upon your leveling and location, the compensation for this role averages between $130,000 and $150,000 USD base salary. Equity, an annual performance bonus, and the benefits outlined above are also part of this role’s package.

description:
Crypto.com is seeking a CRM Manager to lead the strategy and execution of cross-channel communications across our product verticals. Key functions will include driving platform retention, engagement, onboarding, and usage metrics, via channels including but not limited to push notifications, email, in-app etc.

The CRM Manager will work closely with Marketing, Product, Creative, Legal, Compliance, and MarTech teams to deliver campaigns that are timely, compliant, and audience-right. The CRM Manager must demonstrate a deep understanding of the company's products and the customer lifecycle, identify consumer touchpoints, and develop actionable strategies to meet business objectives and customers' needs. The ideal candidate should possess strong leadership and communication skills, be highly organized and detail-oriented, embrace AI as a force multiplier, and be capable of managing multiple projects and workstreams simultaneously in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment.

Responsibilities

•
Own lifecycle CRM strategy across product verticals, driving engagement, retention, onboarding, and reactivation through targeted campaigns and personalized experiences.

•
Design and execute end-to-end marketing automation — from segmentation and journey architecture through to delivery, measurement, and iteration — across email, push, in-app, and in-browser channels.

•
Develop deep ownership of the CRM tech stack — including segmentation logic, channel configuration, data flows, and automation architecture — to operate effectively and surface improvement opportunities.

•
Partner with the MarTech team to build and maintain API-based triggers, data integrations, and real-time event pipelines that power scalable, data-driven campaign delivery.

•
Write and maintain HTML/CSS for email and in-browser templates, ensuring consistency with brand guidelines, responsive design, and cross-client rendering quality.

•
Leverage customer behavioral data and signals to craft personalized experiences, drive upsell, and expand user usage across products.

•
Apply CRM best practices in personalization, A/B testing, journey design, and attribution — continuously raising the bar on execution quality and measurable impact.

•
Leverage AI and machine learning tools to enhance personalization, optimize send times, improve content generation, and scale campaign operations.

•
Own campaign reporting and performance analysis; translate data into actionable insights to optimize messaging, timing, segmentation, and channel mix.

•
Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Creative, Legal, Compliance, and Tech for go-to-market strategies aligned with business priorities.

•
Coordinate with regional legal and compliance teams to ensure CRM activities comply with local regulations, particularly in regulated markets.

•
Develop engagement strategies such as gamification, challenges, and reward mechanics to enhance platform stickiness and drive key usage metrics (e.g., DAU/MAU, transactions, purchases).

Requirements

•
Minimum 4–6 years of experience in CRM, Lifecycle Marketing, Growth, or Retention Marketing roles.

•
Hands-on experience with CRM and CDP platforms, particularly Braze; proficient in building, QAing, and optimizing campaigns directly in the tool.

•
Technical proficiency in HTML/CSS for email and in-browser message development; experience with responsive design and cross-client rendering.

•
Familiarity with REST APIs and how CRM platforms consume event data and integrate with external systems; ability to work alongside MarTech and engineering teams on integrations.

•
Strong command of CRM setup and operations — segmentation architecture, channel logic, data integration, and automation flows.

•
Analytical proficiency in campaign performance analysis; comfort with BI tools and data querying. SQL experience is a strong plus.

•
Demonstrated interest in applying AI tools to CRM workflows — content generation, predictive segmentation, send-time optimization, or operational automation.

•
Solid understanding of lifecycle marketing best practices: personalization, journey design, A/B testing, and campaign attribution.

•
Strong organizational skills — able to manage multiple campaigns and workstreams simultaneously with a high degree of accuracy.

•
Strong cross-functional communication skills; comfortable navigating between Marketing, Product, Legal, and Tech teams.

•
Knowledge of digital assets, cryptocurrency, and Web3 ecosystems is highly preferred.

•
Experience in a regulated industry (crypto, fintech, gaming) is a strong advantage.

Overview
Lease Planning Manager
Provide planning, scheduling, and schedule assurance support for Microsoft leased data center construction projects across the SEA region.

Responsibilities
Roles and Responsibilities

• Perform monthly review and assessment of Integrated Master Schedules (IMS) submitted by Lease Providers (LPs), validating schedule credibility, critical path integrity, logic sequencing, durations, progress updates, and overall schedule health.

• Conduct schedule compliance reviews to ensure Lease Provider schedules align with Microsoft Lease Schedule specifications, reporting expectations, and provide guidance to drive compliance improvements.

• Develop independent schedule forecasts and delivery outlooks using planning methodologies such Schedule Risk Analysis (SRA), trend/interpolation analysis, and progress performance assessment.

• Identify, analyse, and communicate schedule risks, delay indicators, critical path concerns, float erosion, and potential delivery impacts to project teams and management.

• Update Microsoft IMS in the P6 EPPM following the set data schema, making sure the BL, UD and Microsoft RFS dates are updated.

• Cross check the data analytics such as TSR scorecard, duration benchmark, variance or others available in the AI tools or platform to make sure they reflect the correct status and all the data available

• Review pre-award / SOQ project schedules and high-level delivery plans submitted by prospective Lease Providers, providing independent assessment on schedule realism, feasibility, and risk exposure. Ensure the schedule reflects the full scope of work.

• Support management decision-making through schedule analytics, forecasting, reporting, and recommendations across active and pipeline lease projects.

• Engage with Lease Providers or internal Microsoft stakeholders to clarify schedule assumptions, resolve planning issues, and improve schedule quality and consistency.

• Provide portfolio-level planning support across multiple projects within the SEA region, including schedule benchmarking, trend analysis, and regional delivery insights.

• Validate LP baseline schedules within 30 days of lease execution to confirm compliance with LIP requirements, fit-out integration, and milestone maturity.

• Align early with CIA-Lease, DCBM, ITIM, LCM, and project teams on schedule readiness, milestone movements, and decision support.

• Establish creditability as a trusted advisor across functions, driving alignment by ensuring all project dates are centrally governed and communicated by planning lead as single source of truth.

• Convert schedule analysis into executive-ready flash reports and forecast narratives for E2E, CIA-Lease, DCBMs, and leadership stakeholders.

• Maintain governance for RFS and RNI milestone movements by documenting root cause, developer negotiation context, and leadership alignment.

• Ensure fit-out scope is fully integrated into lease schedules and aligned with build sequencing, dependencies, and downstream impacts.

• Validate milestone and RNI movements using critical path logic so that schedule changes are supported before approval.

• Partner with DCBM to assess delay legitimacy, claims, mitigation options, and present a One Microsoft position in developer engagement.

• Support portfolio benchmarking by comparing lease versus build performance across regions and metros using standard planning metrics and normalized duration analysis.

• Support IMS-driven change management by ensuring milestone variances are reviewed, validated, and aligned before updates are reflected in downstream reporting.

• SOQ schedule development support and schedule evaluation outputs for pre-lease execution readiness.

• Baseline schedule validation recommendations following lease execution.

• Monthly TSR scorecards, comments logs, and schedule quality assessments.

• Executive flash reports summarizing baseline versus forecast movement, schedule health, risks, and validated path forward.

• Microsoft IMS schedule updates and milestone confidence assessments.

• Portfolio heat maps and dashboard updates reflecting health status, forecast trends, and regional insights.

• Benchmarking analyses comparing performance by region, metro, project type, and milestone group.

• Swim lane / tracker/app updates recording scorecards, trend movements, and issue follow-up.

• Week 1: Receive Lease Provider schedule submissions, archive XERs, begin health checks, schedule analysis, and initial TSR scoring.

• Week 2: Complete TSR scoring, issue comments logs, update IMS schedules, identify forecast misalignments, and align with stakeholders on key risks.

• Week 3: Track LP responses, validate schedule revisions, update flash reports, and provide forecast clarity on unresolved milestone risks.

• Week 4: Finalize scores, upload dashboard updates, record health and trend movements, and confirm alignment with leadership on schedule confidence and forecast status.

• Participate in weekly E2E meetings

• Participate in solutions and coordination meeting with E2E

• Conduct monthly project controls meetings to discuss project status and RFS forecast based on IMS analysis.

Overview
Cloud Operations and Innovation (CO+I) is the business unit responsible for operating Microsoft’s cloud and the Datacenter Construction Delivery (DCD) team is responsible for constructing datacenter capacity. We have a portfolio of complex, multi-disciplinary, multi-million, multi-year datacenter construction and lease projects underway. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide. We are looking for an individual to help build the network that powers the world’s largest online services.

The role of the Lease Delivery Manager (LDM) requires interpersonal, communication, organizational skills, ability to self-direct, background in datacenter design, engineering, controls, operational requirements, managing teams and vendors, and an emphasis on project/construction management.

The Lease Delivery Manager is ultimately responsible for the complete project delivery of Ready for Service (RFS) for each lease site location. The LDM is responsible for ensuring that each project meets the Data Center Development (DCD) guidelines and standards, which may be adjusted from time-to-time based on best practices and Lesson Learned drawn from previous projects as well as industry changing best practice. In addition, LDM will be responsible for ensuring that the lease provider is complying with the Microsoft requirements in the lease contract when delivering a project.

The LDM will coordinate with Microsoft’s Subject Matter Experts (SME) and stakeholders to support the efforts of achieving RFS for each lease datacenter sites. The LDM will manage the deliveries of projects from lease execution through RFS. In managing the delivery of projects, this position aligns team objectives, business processes, vendor management strategies, and cross-group collaboration efforts with the Data Center Development Project Strategy.

The LDM will be a relentless advocate for managing a safe worksite. Safety is one of the four pillars of CO+I’s mission in delivering cloud capacity; joined by Quality, Schedule adherence, and Cost Management. In addition, this position will be responsible in reviewing potential lease sites providing preconstruction expertise and assisting site selection teams in providing feedback on lease provider’s qualifications.

• The LDM will be a relentless advocate for managing a safe worksite.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.
With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

この役割で担っていただくこと：

• CRMセールスエクゼクティブと一緒に案件の戦略を立て、ServiceNow CRMを選んでいただくための提案とデモをリードします

• お客様の課題に合わせて、ServiceNowならではの価値を、説得力のあるストーリーで伝えます

• CRMセールスエクゼクティブがCRMの価値を提案できるよう、社内のイネーブルメントを企画・支援します

• カスタマーサービス領域とソリューションのエキスパートとして、社内外で専門性を発揮します

• CRMの製品領域の拡大に合わせて、専門性の幅を広げていきます

• プロダクトマネジメントや開発チームと連携し、お客様のニーズを製品の強化につなげます

• 提案のノウハウや成功事例をチームで共有し、チーム全体の提案力を高めます

• 競合や市場のトレンドを常に把握し、提案に活かします

• 事業部門と情報システム部門、両方の意思決定者と対話します

• ユーザーカンファレンス、展示会、アナリスト向けデモ、ウェビナーなどのマーケティング活動を支援します

この役割で成功するために必要なこと：

• 営業部門やカスタマーサービス部門が抱える課題とニーズへの深い理解

• CRMソリューション（Salesforce、Pega、Zendeskなど）でのソリューションコンサルティング経験が7年以上、またはServiceNowプラットフォームでの同等の経験

• お客様にとって重要な価値を見極め、印象に残る形で伝えられるプリセールススキル

• 自社ソリューションの魅力を、社内にも積極的に発信していく意欲

• 経営層、事業部門、技術部門のキーパーソンから信頼を得られる力

• 細かな指示がなくても、自分で仕事を進めて最後までやり遂げる力

• ServiceNowプラットフォームの知識、またはWeb技術の専門知識。新しい技術を素早く習得できること

• プロダクトマネジメント、プロダクトマーケティング、開発チームと連携して仕事を進めた経験

• ServiceNowの価値と競合との違いを、見込み顧客に分かりやすく伝えられること

The role will cover strategic enterprise customers within the Greater China region.

The impact you will have

• Drive new Lakebase revenue by identifying, qualifying, and closing Lakebase opportunities within a defined territory, in partnership with regional Account Executives and the broader account team.

• Lead with outcomes for key Lakebase personas — including platform teams and developers, data teams, and central IT — articulating how Lakebase helps them ship features faster, simplify operational data architectures, and improve governance and cost efficiency.

• Sell the value of fully-managed Postgres for intelligent applications, positioning Lakebase as the optimal choice for operational workloads that power real-time, AI-driven experiences.

• Run complex, multi-threaded sales cycles from discovery and value hypothesis through commercial negotiation and close, navigating executive, technical, and line-of-business stakeholders.

• Orchestrate proof-of-value and POCs that validate Lakebase’s benefits for OLTP-style workloads, reverse ETL, and AI/ML-driven applications, in partnership with solution architects and specialists.

• Compete and win against legacy and cloud-native operational databases by leveraging our compete assets, benchmarks, and customer references.

• Align to measurable business outcomes such as performance, developer productivity, time-to-market for new features, cost reduction, and simplification of the operational data landscape.

• Partner cross-functionally with Product Management, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partner teams to shape territory plans, launch plays, and co-selling motions with key ISVs and GSIs.

• Enable the field by sharing Lakebase best practices, success stories, and sales motions with broader sales teams, helping scale Lakebase proficiency across the organization.

What success looks like in this role

This role requires the ability to operate across two key motions simultaneously:

• Establish top strategic focus accounts by engaging application development teams to create net-new intelligent applications leveraging Lakebase.

• Drive longer-term Postgres standardization and migration within Databricks' most strategic accounts.

Candidates should demonstrate how they can act as a force multiplier across multiple dimensions of the business.

Success in this role requires strength in four areas:

• Business ownership – Operate at a business-unit level by tracking revenue, pipeline, and key observations, and by identifying areas needing additional focus or support.

• Strategic account engagement – Partner with account teams to engage priority accounts across the global DB700, driving strategic opportunities from initial engagement through successful outcomes.

• Field enablement – Build and execute enablement plans that empower AEs and SAs to confidently carry the Lakebase conversation even when the specialist is not present.

• Market voice and thought leadership – Develop an internal and external presence by contributing to global AMAs and internal forums, and by representing Databricks at key first- and third-party events.

The interview process is designed to evaluate candidates across all four of these dimensions.

What we look for

• 7+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience, consistently exceeding quota in complex, multi-stakeholder deals covering Greater China enterprises

• Proven success selling data platforms, operational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, cloud-native DBaaS), or adjacent data/AI infrastructure to technical buyers and business leaders in GCR region.

• Strong understanding of modern data and application architectures, including cloud-native services, microservices, event-driven systems, and how operational data underpins AI and analytics strategies.

• Ability to sell to both technical stakeholders (developers, architects, data engineers) and business stakeholders (product leaders, operations, line-of-business owners).

• Demonstrated experience leading specialist or overlay motions, working jointly with core Account Executives to create and progress opportunities.

• Executive presence with the ability to whiteboard architectures, lead C-level conversations, and build trust with senior decision makers.

• Strong value selling skills: adept at discovering pain, building a business case, and tying technical capabilities to clear, quantified outcomes.

• Excellent communication, storytelling, and negotiation skills, with comfort presenting to both large and small audiences.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience selling Postgres, operational databases, OLTP workloads, or transactional cloud database services, ideally within large or strategic accounts.

• Familiarity with data platforms, lakehouse architectures, and cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP), including how operational databases fit within broader data and AI strategies.

• Understanding of reverse ETL, real-time decisioning, and operational analytics use cases, and how they drive value for customer-facing and internal applications.

• Exposure to AI-native and agent-driven applications that depend on low-latency, highly scalable operational data services.

• インクルーシブな企業文化、コミュニティ・ギルドへの参加機会

• 幅広く手厚い医療関連の福利厚生制度

description:
We are Datadog's in-house product experts. The Technical Enablement Management (TEM) team empowers customers through technical training sessions, ensuring they maximize the value of Datadog. We combine deep technical knowledge with a consultative approach, demonstrating best practices and tailoring training to specific use cases.

As a Manager on this team, you will play a critical role in strengthening our relationships with Sales and Customer Success teams across APJ, developing and coaching the Technical Enablement Managers (TEMs) who report to you, and evolving our enablement programs to better support customer adoption and success. You will lead a distributed team of Technical Enablement Managers covering markets across Asia and ANZ. Manager 2 leaders at Datadog are people-first managers, trusted collaborators, and operational owners. In APJ you will also be the most senior enablement voice in the region, so you will spend as much time building awareness and credibility with Sales and Customer Success as you do managing delivery.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do:

• Own the positioning and enablement strategy for Sales and Customer Success teams in APJ, driving attach rates by positioning training as a value-added service and increasing consumption of complimentary offerings

• Build demand upstream: engage Sales and Customer Success teams across the region at scale, keep positioning and materials current, and drive consistent use of the request process

• Act as the quality gate for incoming work, scoping requests to the right offering, focusing broad asks into targeted sessions, and aligning demand to business need

• Analyze customer training adoption and feedback, evaluating programs for ROI to inform which offerings to scale, evolve, or retire

• Develop sales tools and enablement resources that help internal teams confidently position and sell training to customers

• Drive consistency in training delivery, content utilization and reporting across the team, evaluating delivery quality and distinguishing facilitation gaps from content gaps

• Build and maintain the intake and capacity-planning mechanisms the team runs on, including pre-session questionnaires, triage, prioritisation frameworks and accurate time tracking, and continuously iterate on tooling and processes to improve efficiency and scalability

• Lead, coach and mentor a team of TEMs across APJ, conducting regular 1:1s, performance evaluations and session shadowing, identifying performance gaps early and managing performance formally when coaching alone is not enough

• Proactively monitor team KPIs (utilization, CSAT, productivity, session delivery against demand, and attendance rates), diagnosing trends and gaps, and assign workload so that TEMs achieve an 80% productivity target while balancing training delivery, content creation and enablement activities

• Champion the use of AI tools within the team to improve productivity from content creation and session prep through to reporting and QA, coach TEMs on effective and responsible use, and identify opportunities to apply AI to scale enablement delivery and improve program ROI

• Actively participate in recruiting, hiring and onboarding across the team and the broader organization

• Collaborate with Technical Solutions leadership, Sales, Customer Success, Engineering and Product teams to address urgent needs and implement process improvements

Who You Are:

• An experienced people manager, results-driven, with a strong focus on executing strategies that drive measurable business impact and revenue growth

• A strong coach and mentor who invests in career development and builds inclusive, high-performing teams, and who has authored the things that let a team scale: career progression frameworks, structured onboarding and a consistent coaching cadence

• Has built demand for a services or enablement function by going out to Sales and Customer Success rather than waiting for inbound requests, and can point to a measurable before and after

• A clear communicator who can influence without authority and align stakeholders around common goals

• Energised by bringing a service to new internal audiences, and able to make the case as compellingly on the twentieth telling as on the first

• Able to hold priorities firmly when demands compete, renegotiating scope with partner teams while keeping the relationship strong

• Deliberate about priorities, with a track record of choosing what not to take on and delegating rather than absorbing

• Culturally adaptable across Japan, Korea, Southeast Asia and ANZ, adjusting approach per market rather than applying one style everywhere

• Direct and transparent, setting clear expectations and healthy boundaries, and calm when plans change at short notice

• Exceptionally self-organised, owning their own scheduling, follow-up and administrative rhythm

• A strategic thinker who balances customer needs with business goals, evaluates program ROI and drives cross-functional alignment, with a track record of implementing scalable enablement programs in a growing company

• Data-driven, comfortable using metrics and KPIs to inform decisions and optimize performance

• Demonstrated capability of utilizing AI tooling and scaling it, with a growth mindset of embracing change and being curious

• Technically proficient, with knowledge of modern infrastructure, monitoring solutions, and cloud technologies

• Experienced (5+ years) in Training, Presales, Post-Sales, Consulting, or another customer-facing role, with a history of success

• Educated in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience

• Requires up to 25% travel across the APJ region, primarily to drive and promote enablement adoption with Sales and Customer Success along with team development and cross-functional planning

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you're passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

• Best-in-breed onboarding

• Generous global benefits

• Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking

• New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)

• Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing

description:
As a Manager, Sales Development, you will hire, mentor, develop, and grow a team of Sales Development Representatives. This role impacts one of the largest lines of business in the company through prospect generation and sales pipeline volume, and contributes to molding the future Account Executives and leaders of our sales organization.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

• Hire, oversee, and train a team of Sales Development Representatives (SDR)

• Facilitate the ramp up for all new team members, teaching them how to assess company needs, cater strategically to each prospect, and handle potential objections

• Motivate your team to exceed objectives through coaching, regular broadcast of results, and creative incentives to meet all goals

• Provide growth opportunities for SDRs to develop into full-cycle sales representatives

• Develop and maintain accurate team forecasts for the senior leadership team

Who You Are:

• Experienced in hi-tech direct sales

• Motivated by helping people grow

• Familiar with SaaS/Cloud and Salesforce

• Proven in your written and verbal communication

• Passionate about coaching, mentorship, and team management

• Able to work cross-functionally, leveraging your organizational and time management expertise

• Japanese language proficiency is a requirement as this role focuses on Japanese speaking clients in the region

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your experience, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits and Growth:

• High income earning opportunities based on performance

• Opportunity for Presidents Club

• New hire stock equity (RSU) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)

• Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing

• Sales training in MEDDIC and Command of the Message

• Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking

description:
アカウントエグゼクティブ（Mid-Market担当）

DatadogのMid-Market Salesチームでは、従業員数1,000～5,000名規模の企業をターゲットに、新規顧客の獲得を通じて事業成長を支えるアカウントエグゼクティブ（AE）を募集しています。

本ポジションでは、中堅〜大手企業に対する新規営業活動を戦略的にリードし、契約獲得まで一貫して担当いただきます。

当社の営業メンバーは、明確に定義されたセールスメソッドに基づき、社内ステークホルダーやパートナーエコシステムと連携しながら、顧客ごとの課題やニーズを深く理解し、Datadogのソリューション価値を的確に伝えています。Mid-Market AEとして、営業スキルをさらに磨きながら、Datadogのチームの成功に継続的に貢献できるキャリアパスが用意されています。

Datadogでは、オフィス文化を非常に大切にしています。対面での関係構築やコラボレーションが生む創造性を重視しながらも、ハイブリッドワーク環境を採用することで、一人ひとりに合った柔軟なワークライフバランスの実現を支援しています。

【業務内容】

• 新規ロゴ（新規顧客）獲得に特化した営業活動

• 交渉から技術デモに至るまで、営業サイクル全体をリード

• 商談の背景にあるビジネス要因を正確に把握

• 顧客の業務や事業構造を深く理解し、適切なアプローチを設計

• CTO、エンジニアリング／ITリーダー、SRE・DevOps・DevSecOpsなどの技術系ステークホルダーへの戦略的アプローチ

• 複雑な組織内の複数部門にまたがるマルチスレッド営業

• SDR（Sales Development Representative）、パートナー、マーケティングと連携したリード創出活動

• Sales NavigatorやDemandbaseなどのツールを活用した、リアルタイム信号・リサーチに基づくモダンな営業戦略の実践

【求める人物像】

• 新たなテクノロジーに対する好奇心が強く、それらがビジネス成果とどう関わるかに興味がある方

• 新規顧客開拓（ハンティング）に実績があり、アカウントマッピングや潜在顧客へのアプローチに長けている方

• パイプライン創出スキルが高く、顧客の前でも物怖じせず、自発的かつ創造的に行動できる方

• 出張を含む営業活動に対応可能な方（移動手段：車・電車・飛行機／最大30%）

【待遇・成長機会】

• 成果に応じた高い収入を実現可能

• 成績上位者に贈られる「President’s Club」への選出チャンス

• 入社時に付与されるストックオプション（RSU）および従業員持株購入制度（ESPP）

• 継続的なプロダクト研修、営業・技術両面のトレーニング、明確なキャリアパス

• 社内メンター・バディ制度によるネットワーキング支援

• 多様性を尊重したインクルーシブな企業文化と、社内コミュニティ（Guilds）への参加機会

• グローバルで充実した福利厚生制度

※上記の福利厚生・報酬制度は、勤務国および雇用形態により異なる場合があります。

Datadogでは、多様なバックグラウンドを持つ方々を歓迎しています。すべての要件を初日から満たしている必要はありません。

テクノロジーへの情熱があり、経験を積みたいという意欲がある方は、ぜひご応募ください。あなたの成長を全力でサポートします。

The Field Marketing Team

As a member of Japan Field Marketing in Okta Japan, you will be responsible for the marketing planning and execution for Japan business success.

This role will generate awareness and create demand using a variety of marketing vehicles and tactics including, but not limited to, account-targeted programs, regional and national tradeshows, conferences, targeted field events, demand campaigns and assets, direct mail, webinars and workshops. Their primary objective is to move accounts through the sales pipeline and accelerate the sales cycle for prospects.

You are a results-oriented marketer that gets things done and a roll up your sleeves type of person. The role will require shown ability to effectively work harmoniously with cross-functional internal teams and external vendors.

What you’ll be doing

• Team up with Field and Partner Marketing teams to help Okta Sales deliver on annual revenue pipeline and balance pipeline objectives through the execution of various field / regional events, programs and campaigns and help facilitate lead funnel management across all activities

• Help manage & monitor regional campaigns, programs and event properties, assets, collateral for tradeshows, onsite & online events, sales & field events. Work closely with Sales/SDR on all pre-event preparations

• Execute on event strategy, tactical plans and project manage all logistics, onsite execution and post event analysis for our participation

• Coordinate pre-to-post show event marketing strategies and collect post-event feedback and develop post event reports and analysis

• Effectively work cross-functionally - you will help define, project manage and execute on event program goals, messaging, tactics, audience generation/email campaigns, speaker plan, collateral, post-show leads processing & follow-up and other logistics

• 3-5 years in marketing execution, event creation and campaign management

• Master of multi-tasking, prioritisation, and timelines and has a consistent track record of complex event programs with dynamic partners, multiple product lines, and representing various cross teams within the organisation

• Japanese native and excellent oral and written communication skills in Japanese & English

• Experience managing all aspects of event programs, from planning to reporting and analysis

• Thrives in rapid growth, energising environment and adapts well to change

• A positive, collaborative team player with strong multitasking abilities

• Project management experience covering project planning, event management, promotion and registration, content development, and on-site management

And extra credit if you have experience in any of the following!

• Excellent presentation skills and confidence in communicating with various stakeholders

• Experience with sales and marketing systems – Asana, Salesforce and Marketo, Tableau a plus

• Experience in B2B Technology marketing

description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

役割

セールスと市場開拓（Go-to-Market）部門の一員としてご活躍いただける、アカウント エグゼクティブを募集しています。この職務は日本を拠点とし、リージョナルディレクター直属となります。

世界中のプロフェッショナルと連携しながら、お客様の期待を超える価値提供を実現し、安全でクラウドを前提としたデジタルの未来を推進していくポジションです。
また、Customer Success／Enablement／Architecture各チームと密に協働し、Zscalerが実現するクラウド・トランスフォーメーションの力を提案・体現することで、クラウドセキュリティ分野のグローバルリーダーとしての当社のポジションをさらに強固なものにしていただきます。

業務内容 (役割と期待されること)

・顧客の経営幹部を含む主要な関係者との信頼関係を構築すること。

・顧客の目標に基づく長期的なアカウント戦略を設計すること。

・社内関係者との連携による顧客ニーズを反映したアカウント計画を策定すること。

・ 顧客のビジネスを理解し、具体的な目標を掲げ、Zscalerソリューションを提案し、信頼できるパートナーとしての役割を発揮すること。

求める人物像 (成功のための資質)

不確実さを力に変えられる人 ：正解が見えない状況でも前に進むことが出来る方。歩きながら道をつくることに前向きで、曖昧さを「障害」ではなく、価値あるものを生み出すための素材として捉えられる方。

オーナーシップを持って動ける人 ：ミッションへの熱意が行動力につながり、自ら意思決定し、最後までやり切ることが出来る方。成果に本気で向き合うからこそ誠実にふるまい、戦略の議論から現場の実行まで、必要に応じて自在に行き来できる方。

課題解決を楽しめる人 ：難しい課題ほど熱意をもって取り組める方。課題に集中し、解決までやり抜くことで最大のインパクトを生み出せると知っている方。

信頼をつくるコラボレーター ：自分の成功だけでなく、チームの成功にコミットできる方。明確さと敬意のある率直さを大切にし、フィードバックを「与える・受け取る」を継続できる方。これこそが最高のチームワークであり、信頼を最速で築く方法だと理解している方。

学び続ける人 ：学び続ける姿勢を持っている方。真の成長志向を持ち、自己啓発に情熱を注ぎ、より良いパートナー、より強力なチームメイトになるために積極的にフィードバックを求める方。仕事を心から楽しみ、目的意識を持って取り組める方。

応募資格(必須条件)

・ソフトウェアまたはセキュリティ業界における5年以上のフルサイクルセールス経験

・学士号またはそれに相当する実務経験

・法人顧客との関与および経営幹部への販売を含む戦略的営業の経験

・ビジネスレベルの日本語力(読み書き、会話)

・AI／機械学習（ML）技術の基礎的な理解を有し、自身の担当領域における成果を最大化するために、AIを活用したソリューションの活用・提案・セキュリティ確保のいずれかに携わった経験を有すること

他の候補者との差別化要素(歓迎条件)

・既存顧客や見込み客との確立されたネットワークを活かし、持続的な成果を生み出すスキル

・顧客の目的や課題を深く理解し、テクノロジーによるデジタルトランスフォーメーションの促進についての深い理解

・戦略的な営業計画に関する知識と新規顧客を獲得した実績

・AIを活用したセールスインテリジェンス、予測予測、あるいは会話型AIプラットフォームを活用した経験があり、エンタープライズ領域のテリトリープランニングやパイプラインの加速化を最適化できること

役割

セールスと市場開拓（Go-to-Market）部門の一員としてご活躍いただける、アカウント エグゼクティブを募集しています。この職務は日本を拠点とし、リージョナルディレクター直属となります。

世界中のプロフェッショナルと連携しながら、お客様の期待を超える価値提供を実現し、安全でクラウドを前提としたデジタルの未来を推進していくポジションです。
また、Customer Success／Enablement／Architecture各チームと密に協働し、Zscalerが実現するクラウド・トランスフォーメーションの力を提案・体現することで、クラウドセキュリティ分野のグローバルリーダーとしての当社のポジションをさらに強固なものにしていただきます。

業務内容 (役割と期待されること)

・顧客の経営幹部を含む主要な関係者との信頼関係を構築すること。

・顧客の目標に基づく長期的なアカウント戦略を設計すること。

・社内関係者との連携による顧客ニーズを反映したアカウント計画を策定すること。

・ 顧客のビジネスを理解し、具体的な目標を掲げ、Zscalerソリューションを提案し、信頼できるパートナーとしての役割を発揮すること。

求める人物像 (成功のための資質)

不確実さを力に変えられる人 ：正解が見えない状況でも前に進むことが出来る方。歩きながら道をつくることに前向きで、曖昧さを「障害」ではなく、価値あるものを生み出すための素材として捉えられる方。

オーナーシップを持って動ける人 ：ミッションへの熱意が行動力につながり、自ら意思決定し、最後までやり切ることが出来る方。成果に本気で向き合うからこそ誠実にふるまい、戦略の議論から現場の実行まで、必要に応じて自在に行き来できる方。

課題解決を楽しめる人 ：難しい課題ほど熱意をもって取り組める方。課題に集中し、解決までやり抜くことで最大のインパクトを生み出せると知っている方。

信頼をつくるコラボレーター ：自分の成功だけでなく、チームの成功にコミットできる方。明確さと敬意のある率直さを大切にし、フィードバックを「与える・受け取る」を継続できる方。これこそが最高のチームワークであり、信頼を最速で築く方法だと理解している方。

学び続ける人 ：学び続ける姿勢を持っている方。真の成長志向を持ち、自己啓発に情熱を注ぎ、より良いパートナー、より強力なチームメイトになるために積極的にフィードバックを求める方。仕事を心から楽しみ、目的意識を持って取り組める方。

応募資格(必須条件)

・ソフトウェアまたはセキュリティ業界における5年以上のフルサイクルセールス経験

・学士号またはそれに相当する実務経験

・法人顧客との関与および経営幹部への販売を含む戦略的営業の経験

・ビジネスレベルの日本語力(読み書き、会話)

・AI／機械学習（ML）技術の基礎的な理解を有し、自身の担当領域における成果を最大化するために、AIを活用したソリューションの活用・提案・セキュリティ確保のいずれかに携わった経験を有すること

他の候補者との差別化要素(歓迎条件)

・既存顧客や見込み客との確立されたネットワークを活かし、持続的な成果を生み出すスキル

・顧客の目的や課題を深く理解し、テクノロジーによるデジタルトランスフォーメーションの促進についての深い理解

・戦略的な営業計画に関する知識と新規顧客を獲得した実績

・AIを活用したセールスインテリジェンス、予測予測、あるいは会話型AIプラットフォームを活用した経験があり、エンタープライズ領域のテリトリープランニングやパイプラインの加速化を最適化できること

セールスと市場開拓（Go-to-Market）部門の一員としてご活躍いただける、アカウント エグゼクティブを募集しています。この職務は日本を拠点とし、リージョナルディレクター直属となります。

世界中のプロフェッショナルと連携しながら、お客様の期待を超える価値提供を実現し、安全でクラウドを前提としたデジタルの未来を推進していくポジションです。
また、Customer Success／Enablement／Architecture各チームと密に協働し、Zscalerが実現するクラウド・トランスフォーメーションの力を提案・体現することで、クラウドセキュリティ分野のグローバルリーダーとしての当社のポジションをさらに強固なものにしていただきます。

・社内関係者との連携による顧客ニーズを反映したアカウント計画を策定すること。

・ 顧客のビジネスを理解し、具体的な目標を掲げ、Zscalerソリューションを提案し、信頼できるパートナーとしての役割を発揮すること。

求める人物像 (成功のための資質)

不確実さを力に変えられる人 ：正解が見えない状況でも前に進むことが出来る方。歩きながら道をつくることに前向きで、曖昧さを「障害」ではなく、価値あるものを生み出すための素材として捉えられる方。

オーナーシップを持って動ける人 ：ミッションへの熱意が行動力につながり、自ら意思決定し、最後までやり切ることが出来る方。成果に本気で向き合うからこそ誠実にふるまい、戦略の議論から現場の実行まで、必要に応じて自在に行き来できる方。

課題解決を楽しめる人 ：難しい課題ほど熱意をもって取り組める方。課題に集中し、解決までやり抜くことで最大のインパクトを生み出せると知っている方。

信頼をつくるコラボレーター ：自分の成功だけでなく、チームの成功にコミットできる方。明確さと敬意のある率直さを大切にし、フィードバックを「与える・受け取る」を継続できる方。これこそが最高のチームワークであり、信頼を最速で築く方法だと理解している方。

学び続ける人 ：学び続ける姿勢を持っている方。真の成長志向を持ち、自己啓発に情熱を注ぎ、より良いパートナー、より強力なチームメイトになるために積極的にフィードバックを求める方。仕事を心から楽しみ、目的意識を持って取り組める方。

・ソフトウェアまたはセキュリティ業界における8年以上のフルサイクルセールス経験

・学士号またはそれに相当する実務経験

・法人顧客との関与および経営幹部への販売を含む戦略的営業の経験

・ビジネスレベルの日本語力(読み書き、会話)

・AI／機械学習（ML）技術の基礎的な理解を有し、自身の担当領域における成果を最大化するために、AIを活用したソリューションの活用・提案・セキュリティ確保のいずれかに携わった経験を有すること

他の候補者との差別化要素(歓迎条件)

・既存顧客や見込み客との確立されたネットワークを活かし、持続的な成果を生み出すスキル

・顧客の目的や課題を深く理解し、テクノロジーによるデジタルトランスフォーメーションの促進についての深い理解

・戦略的な営業計画に関する知識と新規顧客を獲得した実績

・AIを活用したセールスインテリジェンス、予測予測、あるいは会話型AIプラットフォームを活用した経験があり、エンタープライズ領域のテリトリープランニングやパイプラインの加速化を最適化できること

Distribution Strategy & Business Planning:

Manage business plans with distribution partners. Set quarterly targets for the pipeline and for recruiting resellers. Prioritize segments for Elastic's Enterprise, Public Sector, and Commercial business.

Proven ability to independently deliver sales pitches and business value proposition to partners, ability to showcase product or solution demos, co-deliver hands-on workshops, and lab-based training — to Sales and technical audiences (SEs, architects, pre-sales).

This position is to play a key role as part of the growth strategy of Twilio Japan by winning new customers. You will be responsible for developing a strategy to acquire new customers for Twilio, collaborate with internal stakeholders, such as demand generation marketing, digital sales, partner managers and system engineers. Our customers are often application owners, product managers, line of business executives, CxO’s, Head’s of invitation, omni channel and digital strategy partners. Customer industries and segments are also spread from retail, financial services, manufacturing, transportation, public sectors, independent software vendors, system integrators and fast moving technology startups

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

• Develop and implement a comprehensive territory plan, winning strategy for target accounts, execute and adjust plan and priorities to maximize results of winning new customers and its business.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders, align shared goals and strategy and obtain support from them

• Forecast the business, including sales funnel management, systematic follow up and discipline by utilizing SFDC and its supplement tools as source of truth for business and its pipelines.

• Be an active spokesperson for Twilio Mission, Vision and Value, Corporate Story to our customers, potential customers, and any external partners who collaborate.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

• 5+ years of combined experience in high-touch sales experience.

• Comfortable working with business and highly technical leaders, while influencing their understanding and building supportive partnerships.

• Demonstrated track record of growth of business, growth strategy development and execution.

• Challenger mindset with appetite to acquire new business and customers

• Record of delivering market driven results, especially to scale and enterprise customers

• Business-level proficiency in English (both spoken and written) is preferred to effectively collaborate with internal stakeholders.

Desired:

• Deep experience working with telecom companies, including SMS aggregators, carriers, or global communications platforms

• Software, SaaS, CPaaS or CCaaS experience

• Cloud Technology Sales - IaaS/PaaS, virtualization, security

• Experience working with/at System Integrators, Resell and Value-Added resellers to drive large and broad customer coverage with external partner organizations

Location

This role will be remote, and based in Japan

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 25% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

description:
About Team & About Role
Rubrik’s Channel team is how we bring cyber resilience to the organizations across Japan that people rely on every day, including hospitals, banks, government bodies, manufacturers and utilities. As Channel Development Manager for Japan, you’ll own the relationships with our reseller, SI and distribution partners and turn them into a repeatable engine for pipeline and Partner Initiated Deals. This is an individual contributor role with real autonomy over which partners you invest in, how you plan with them, and how fast you help them grow.

Rubrikのチャネルチームは、病院、銀行、官公庁、製造業、公益事業など、人々の日常を支える日本全国の組織にサイバーレジリエンスを届ける役割を担っています。日本担当チャネルデベロップメントマネージャーとして、リセラー、SI、ディストリビューターとのパートナーリレーションを統括し、パイプラインとパートナー起点の案件(Partner Initiated Deals)を継続的に生み出す仕組みへと育てていただきます。本ポジションは個人貢献型(IC)の役割で、どのパートナーに投資するか、パートナーとどのように計画を立てるか、そしてパートナーの成長をどれだけ早く後押しするかについて、大きな裁量があります。

What You’ll Do

• Build and execute joint business plans with key Japan resellers, SIs and distributors, so partners have a clear path to growing their Rubrik business and Rubrik has a clear view of where it will come from.

• Drive Partner Initiated Deals and net-new pipeline by working with partner sales teams to identify, qualify and close opportunities alongside Rubrik Account Executives.

• Run account mapping and joint planning sessions between Rubrik field teams and partners, opening access to partner customer bases, both existing accounts and new logos.

• Lead enablement for partner sales and SE teams, so partners can position, demo and deploy Rubrik independently and customers see value from day one.

• Develop and manage distribution relationships, using them to extend Rubrik’s reach into the mid-market, public sector and regional enterprise accounts.

• Identify, onboard and grow new partners that fill gaps in regional, vertical or solution coverage.

• Work with Channel Marketing and Field Marketing to plan and host partner and customer events and campaigns that put Rubrik in front of the right buyers.

• Build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers at your partners, earning Rubrik a place as a strategic vendor in their portfolio.

• Report on partner performance, pipeline and forecast to Channel and Sales leadership, giving the business a clear read on Japan.

主な業務内容

• 日本の主要なリセラー、SI、ディストリビューターと共同ビジネスプランを策定・実行し、パートナーがRubrikビジネスを拡大するための明確な道筋と、Rubrikが売上の見通しを把握できる状態をつくる。

• パートナーの営業チームと連携し、Rubrikのアカウントエグゼクティブとともに商談の発掘、案件化、クロージングを行い、パートナー起点の案件と新規パイプラインを創出する。

• Rubrikのフィールドチームとパートナーとの間で、アカウントマッピングおよび共同プランニングセッションを実施し、既存顧客・新規顧客の両面でパートナーの顧客基盤へのアクセスを広げる。

• パートナーの営業チームおよびSEチームのイネーブルメントをリードし、パートナーが自立してRubrikの提案、デモ、導入を行え、お客様が初日から価値を実感できる状態をつくる。

• ディストリビューターとの関係を構築・管理し、ミッドマーケット、公共部門、地方の大企業顧客へのリーチを拡大する。

• 地域、業種、ソリューションのカバレッジに不足がある領域で、新規パートナーを発掘、オンボーディングし、成長を支援する。

• チャネルマーケティングおよびフィールドマーケティングと連携し、適切な購買層にRubrikを届けるパートナー向け・顧客向けのイベントやキャンペーンを企画・開催する。

• パートナーの経営層・意思決定者との信頼関係を築き、パートナーのポートフォリオにおけるRubrikの戦略的ベンダーとしての地位を確立する。

• パートナーの実績、パイプライン、フォーキャストをチャネルおよびセールスのリーダーシップに報告し、日本の状況を明確に共有する。

Experience You’ll Need

• Strong track record in a channel development, channel sales or partner management role at a technology vendor, working with resellers, SIs and distributors in Japan.

• An Account Executive who has successfully managed client accounts may transition into a Channel Development Manager role.

• Good working knowledge of the data protection, data management, cybersecurity or storage market.

• Established relationships and a strong reputation with Japan partners and distributors.

• Experience identifying, initiating and closing deals with partners in close coordination with direct sales teams.

• Experience running quarterly and annual planning for partner sales activity and reporting on pipeline and forecast.

• Confidence presenting to larger audiences and hosting events with partners and end customers.

• A collaborative approach to working across Sales, Systems Engineering, Marketing, Alliances and Sales Operations.

• Business-level fluency in Japanese and English proficiency at a beginner level, to work with Japan partners and with regional and global teams.

求める経験・スキル

• テクノロジーベンダーにおけるチャネルデベロップメント、チャネルセールス、またはパートナーマネジメントの実績があり、日本のリセラー、SI、ディストリビューターと協業した経験

• 顧客アカウントの運営で成果を上げたアカウントエグゼクティブが、チャネルデベロップメントマネージャーへ転身することも可能です

• データ保護、データ管理、サイバーセキュリティ、またはストレージ市場に関する実務的な知識

• 日本のパートナーおよびディストリビューターとの確立した関係と高い評価

• 直販チームと緊密に連携し、パートナーとの案件の発掘、開始、クロージングを行った経験

• パートナー営業活動の四半期・年間計画の策定と、パイプラインおよびフォーキャストの報告の経験

• 大規模な聴衆の前でのプレゼンテーションや、パートナー・エンドユーザーとのイベント開催に自信を持って取り組める方

• セールス、システムエンジニアリング、マーケティング、アライアンス、セールスオペレーションと協力して業務を進める協調的な姿勢

• 日本のパートナーや地域・グローバルチームと業務を行うための、ビジネスレベルの日本語、および初級レベルの英語力

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience selling or partnering on competitive backup and recovery or cyber resilience solutions.

• A background running partner enablement or training programs.

• Experience building joint solutions with adjacent security and infrastructure vendors (e.g. identity, endpoint, network or storage).

• Experience acquiring and onboarding new partners.

• 競合するバックアップ・リカバリーまたはサイバーレジリエンスソリューションの販売、またはそれらでのパートナー協業の経験

Rubrik's sales organization helps hospitals, banks, schools and government agencies stay resilient against cyberattacks, malicious insiders and operational disruption, and you'll do it for one of the fastest-growing corners of the data estate: unstructured data on NAS. As the Sales Specialist for NAS Cloud Direct, you own the number for this product in your territory. You'll be the go-to expert in the field, with the tools, enablement and One Rubrik selling motion to take your career, and your earnings, as far as your results allow.

You'll work alongside Core Account Executives, Sales Engineers, Sales Development, Channel Development and our partners, and you'll be the consolidated voice of the field and customer back to Product Management, Product Marketing and PnP.

What You'll Do

• Own bookings growth for NAS Cloud Direct across new and existing accounts, building and executing a territory plan that meets and exceeds quota

• Drive daily pipeline generation to land net new logos, opening doors with customers who need to protect massive volumes of unstructured data without adding more on-prem backup infrastructure

• Qualify, build and close strategic opportunities in mid-enterprise accounts, and expand within the existing Rubrik base alongside Core AEs

• Present NAS Cloud Direct within complex data center and cloud design conversations, helping customers see how they get faster, simpler recovery from ransomware and other disruption

• Co-sell with Core AEs, Sales Engineers, distributors, resellers and VARs to build repeatable partner-led momentum

• Champion and evangelize the product inside and outside Rubrik, training the field on positioning, objection handling and competitive differentiation so more teams can sell it with confidence

• Bring market and customer feedback to Product Management and Product Marketing, shaping what we build next and how we take it to market

• Share what's working with fellow Product Line Specialists, so the whole team learns faster

Experience You'll Need

• 5+ years of field technology sales experience, ideally selling data protection, storage, cloud infrastructure or NAS-related solutions

• A consistent track record of landing net new logos and consistently overachieving quota

• Strong experience building and managing pipeline across many accounts and verticals

• Comfort positioning a technical product in complex data center and cloud environments, and building champions across technical and business buyers

• Experience working with channel partners, distributors and resellers to co-sell and grow a territory

• A driven, goal-oriented "get it done" mindset and the self-direction to generate your own momentum

Preferred Qualifications

• Exposure to unstructured data challenges and enterprise NAS platforms

• Experience selling complex, multi-stakeholder solutions into mid-enterprise accounts

• Background in product-specialist or overlay sales models

• Familiarity with the competitive landscape in data protection and cloud storage

• Understanding of MEDDPICC for sales qualification & COtM sales methodology

Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation

Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.

Small Enterprise Account Executive, Japan

Rubrik’s Sales organization is a united group of elite cross-functional sales professionals that help companies & government entities achieve resilience against cyberattacks, malicious insiders, and operational disruptions. We offer continuous professional growth and opportunity through our world-class sales enablement program. Our One Rubrik selling approach provides all the resources you need to exceed your goals, maximize your earnings potential, and take your career to the next level. All this while doing something truly purposeful, protecting the world's data.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you’ll own new logo growth across Japan’s large enterprise market, with the autonomy to shape your territory and the backing of a global team and a world-class enablement program to take your career to the next level. We are seeking a relentless self-starter who is hyper-focused on acquiring new logos by discovering and developing new opportunities, managing pipeline, and executing account strategies, while also encouraging existing customer expansion. The AE must drive pipeline generation daily while working with Sales Engineers, Sales Development, Channel Development, and Rubrik Channel Partners to exceed sales quotas.

• Define and execute a territory plan for Japan’s large enterprise accounts, owning bookings growth from first conversation to close

• Generate net new pipeline through your own prospecting and outreach, opening doors at accounts that have never worked with Rubrik

• Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, using a disciplined qualification methodology to forecast accurately and win

• Present Rubrik’s cyber resilience solutions in complex data center and cloud environments, helping customers see how fast they can recover when it matters most

• Partner with Sales Engineers, Sales Development, Channel Development, and Rubrik partners to co-sell and scale your territory

• Share local market insight with Rubrik leadership, helping shape how we grow in Japan

• Collaborate with and learn from a high-performing One Rubrik sales team that invests in your continued growth

主な業務内容

• 日本の大企業アカウントを対象としたテリトリープランを策定・実行し、最初の商談からクローズまで、ブッキングの成長に責任を持つ

• 自らのプロスペクティングとアウトリーチを通じて新規パイプラインを創出し、Rubrikとこれまで取引のなかった企業との接点を開拓する

• 複雑なデータセンターおよびクラウド環境において、Rubrikのサイバーレジリエンス・ソリューションを提案し、いざという時にどれだけ迅速に復旧できるかをお客様に示す

• セールスエンジニア、セールス・デベロップメント、チャネル・デベロップメント、Rubrikのパートナーと連携し、共同で販売を進めながらテリトリーを拡大する

• 現地市場に関する知見をRubrikのリーダーシップと共有し、日本での成長戦略の策定に貢献する

• 継続的な成長を支援する、高いパフォーマンスを誇る「One Rubrik」セールスチームと協働し、互いに学び合う

Experience You’ll Need

• 8+ years of enterprise Account Executive experience selling Security, Infrastructure, Data, or SaaS solutions

• A track record of landing net new logos in large enterprise accounts, with at least 3 years at a large company (1,000+ employees) and experience in a hypergrowth environment (ideally large company followed by startup or scale-up)

• Strong, consistent achievement as an AE, evidenced by President’s Club, top-performer awards, or sustained quota attainment

• Proven ability to self-source deals and build pipeline from scratch through your own outbound prospecting, rather than relying on customer or partner referrals

• A repeatable new logo pipeline generation process you can walk us through, from cold account to qualified opportunity

• Hands-on experience with MEDDIC or MEDDPICC, or another proven enterprise qualification methodology

• A stable career with meaningful tenure and measurable impact in each role

• Experience working with channel partners and selling complex solutions

求めるご経験

• セキュリティ、インフラ、データ、またはSaaSソリューションを扱うエンタープライズ・アカウントエグゼクティブとしての10年以上の経験

• 大企業アカウントにおける新規顧客(ニューロゴ)獲得の実績。大手企業(従業員1,000名以上)での3年以上の勤務経験、およびハイパーグロース環境での経験(大手企業からスタートアップ、スケールアップへというキャリアが望ましい)

• President’s Club、トップパフォーマー表彰、または継続的なクォータ達成などで裏付けられた、AEとしての安定した高い実績

• 顧客やパートナーからの紹介に頼らず、自らのアウトバウンド活動によって案件を創出し、ゼロからパイプラインを構築した実証済みの能力

• 未開拓のアカウントから有望な商談(クオリファイド・オポチュニティ)に至るまでの、再現性のあるニューロゴ・パイプライン創出プロセスを具体的に説明できること

• MEDDICまたはMEDDPICC、もしくはそれに準ずる実績のあるエンタープライズ向け案件評価手法の実務経験

• 各職務において意義ある在籍期間と測定可能な成果を残してきた、安定したキャリア

• チャネルパートナーとの協業経験、および複雑なソリューションの販売経験

Above all, you will have the ability to operate in a fast-paced, changing environment, self-starter, and operate in a highly matrixed organization. Demonstrate Rubrik’s RIVET values and be a role model, collaborating effectively and creating a positive environment .

何よりも、変化の激しい環境で成果を出せること、自ら率先して行動できること、そしてマトリックス型の組織で円滑に仕事を進められることが重要です。RubrikのRIVETバリューを体現し、ロールモデルとして、周囲と効果的に協働しながら、前向きな職場環境を築いていただける方を求めています。

description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Singapore

About the Department

The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. Account Executives, Customer Engineers, Partner Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Customer Experience Managers, Professional Services and Revenue Operations work as a continuous engine — winning, deploying, adopting, expanding, and scaling platform commitments across the full customer lifecycle.

The system is supported by an AI-embedded operating model. The work itself, however, remains human. The role of every seller at Cloudflare is to bring critical thinking, judgment, and trust to customer relationships and outcomes.

About This Role

In this role, you will be responsible for driving significant growth by landing and expanding a portfolio of public sector and enterprise accounts in the Philippines market . The ideal candidate possesses a strong blend of sales acumen and technical understanding, enabling them to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical buyers. As an Account Executive, you will drive revenue velocity by utilizing foundational sales data layers for accurate forecasting, proactive pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets.

You are the kind of operator who uses AI as a force multiplier every day, cares more about customer outcomes than job boundaries, and demonstrates curiosity, judgment, and high agency.

Role Responsibilities

• Own and execute a comprehensive territory plan to consistently achieve and exceed sales and revenue targets.

• Cultivate long-term strategic relationships with key accounts and partners. Lead executive-level transformation narratives that earn the right to be in the architecture conversation.

• Leverage top partners as an extension of the sales team to co-sell alongside where they bring customer relationships, services capability, or procurement leverage. Drive regular forecast & pipeline cadences with top partners.

• Understand customer network architectures, the problems that Cloudflare can solve and effectively translate Cloudflare’s solutions to drive successful platform sales, ensuring clients can secure and scale their own AI-driven workloads.

• Manage contract negotiations and structure platform-level commercial commitments (multi-year, multi-product, outcome-anchored) rather than point-product deals.

• Stay engaged through onboarding, adoption, and the first renewal. Partner with Customer Engineers, Professional Services on a deployment plan with milestones tied to measurable outcomes.

• Proactively build and manage a robust sales pipeline by leveraging internal tools, AI-assisted research and pipeline sources (BDR, Channel, Marketing).

• Maintain high standards in pipeline discipline, CRM hygiene and forecasting accuracy.

Required Experience

• Fluent in English and Tagalog to engage with customers in Philippines

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.

• Experience selling technology solutions in high-growth technology firms.

• Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting and exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.

• Proficient in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and multi-threaded land and expand strategies.

• Strong understanding of computer networking, cloud security technology, and how enterprise infrastructure adapts to automated data workflows.

• Exceptional interpersonal communication skills and value selling skills.

• Proficiency in modern sales software, customer data environments, and core systems (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite).

• Thinks critically rather than reacting, exercises judgment under uncertainty, names risks honestly, shows genuine empathy for customers as people, can point to relationships built over time on trust, and demonstrates visible curiosity in how they prepare, sell, and learn.

• Willingness to actively engage with AI tools and experiment.

• Ability to travel as required.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations

• Singapore

About the Role

The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. Account Executives, Customer Engineers, Partner Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Customer Experience Managers, Professional Services and Revenue Operations work as a continuous engine - winning, deploying, adopting, expanding, and scaling platform commitments across the full customer lifecycle.

The system is supported by an AI-embedded operating model. The work itself, however, remains human. The role of every seller at Cloudflare is to bring critical thinking, judgment, and trust to customer relationships and outcomes.

In this role, you will be responsible for driving significant growth by landing and expanding a portfolio of assigned customers in Enterprise accounts of the Thailand market . The ideal candidate possesses a strong blend of sales acumen and technical understanding, enabling them to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical buyers. As an Account Executive, you will drive revenue velocity by utilizing foundational sales data layers for accurate forecasting, proactive pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets.

You are the kind of operator who uses AI as a force multiplier every day, cares more about customer outcomes than job boundaries, and demonstrates curiosity, judgment, and high agency.

Responsibilities

• Own and execute a comprehensive territory plan to consistently achieve and exceed sales and revenue targets.

• Cultivate long-term strategic relationships with key accounts and partners. Lead executive-level transformation narratives that earn the right to be in the architecture conversation.

• Leverage top partners as an extension of the sales team to co-sell alongside where they bring customer relationships, services capability, or procurement leverage. Drive regular forecast & pipeline cadences with top partners.

• Understand customer network architectures, the problems that Cloudflare can solve and effectively translate Cloudflare’s solutions to drive successful platform sales, ensuring clients can secure and scale their own AI-driven workloads.

• Manage contract negotiations and structure platform-level commercial commitments (multi-year, multi-product, outcome-anchored) rather than point-product deals.

• Stay engaged through onboarding, adoption, and the first renewal. Partner with Customer Engineers, Professional Services on a deployment plan with milestones tied to measurable outcomes.

• Proactively build and manage a robust sales pipeline by leveraging internal tools, AI-assisted research and pipeline sources (BDR, Channel, Marketing).

• Maintain high standards in pipeline discipline, CRM hygiene and forecasting accuracy.

• Experienced sales professional with deep relationships with C-level executives from the largest enterprises in Thailand

• Experienced sales professional who has closed strategic deals with the largest enterprises in Thailand

• Bachelor's degree required.

• Experience selling technology solutions in high-growth technology firms.

• Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting and exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.

• Proficient in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and multi-threaded land and expand strategies.

• Strong understanding of computer networking, cloud security technology, and how enterprise infrastructure adapts to automated data workflows.

• Exceptional interpersonal communication skills and value selling skills.

• Proficiency in modern sales software, customer data environments, and core systems (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite).

• Thinks critically rather than reacting, exercises judgment under uncertainty, names risks honestly, shows genuine empathy for customers as people, can point to relationships built over time on trust, and demonstrates visible curiosity in how they prepare, sell, and learn.

• Willingness to actively engage with AI tools and experiment.

• Ability to travel as required.

• The portfolio for this role consists of customers based in Thailand. Proficiency in Thai to communicate with these customers would be required.

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

As one of the founding members of our Customer Success team in Japan, you'll help shape how we build the function in-region. • Own the customer experience across their lifecycle: manage comprehensive account and success plans grounded in the customer's business objectives, conduct Quarterly Business Reviews, and serve as the primary conduit between the customer and Anthropic

Minimum qualifications

• Experience in customer-facing roles (Customer Success, Consulting, Solutions Architect, Solutions/Functional Consultant, Success Engineer or similar)

• Technical fluency with ability to understand and articulate AI/ML concepts, API integrations, and software implementation patterns

• Experience explaining and demonstrating technical products to various audiences

• Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple customer relationships

• Passion for AI and interest in responsible development of advanced systems

• Fluency in English and Japanese

Preferred qualifications

• 6+ years of experience in relevant field

• Experience driving success across both consumption-based and seat-based business models, with understanding of different expansion levers and success metrics for each

• Cross-functional collaborator who represents the customer in a positive, proactive manner, rallying everyone around paths forward that solve customer needs

• You are knowledgeable and experienced in the end to end claims process and take full ownership for reaching a complete final resolution with care and attention

• A track record of strong leadership in handling issues and escalations

• Demonstrated capacity for critical thinking, research, and analysis; strong attention to detail

• Experience working in a matrix and driving solutions to complex problems through cross-functional collaboration

• Fluency in data analysis and demonstrated use of AI tools to create operational leverage — with the discipline to validate any output and the judgment to know what should not be delegated to a model

• Proven ability to develop and maintain strategic partnerships, balancing partner needs with business objectives to create long-term value.
