You will work with regional and global Editorial partners, Japan Creator Partnerships, Product and Sales to improve content quality, support business needs and bring Japanese seasonal and cultural trends to life on Pinterest.

What you’ll do

• Curate visually compelling, culturally relevant and inclusive content for Japanese Pinners across a range of categories including Entertainment, Art, Fashion or Beauty and seasonal moments.

• Execute editorial programming from content selection, Japanese copywriting and visual assets handling through launch, performance review and optimization.

• Create, edit and review Japanese headlines, descriptions, articles, page copy, emails and localized materials for accuracy, natural expression, brand consistency and local relevance.

• Plan and develop optimized web or email contents for the Japanese audience.

• Curate content that supports client and business needs while maintaining a useful, inspiring Pinner experience.

• Use platform data, search behavior and market signals to identify trends, audience needs and opportunities to improve content quality and new-user acquisition.

• Share performance insights and editorial recommendations with cross-functional and global stakeholders.

• Use AI tools to improve research, analysis and workflow efficiency, while independently validating output for accuracy, cultural nuance, quality and brand safety; own final editorial decisions.

• Manage multiple priorities and stay current on Japanese trends, creators, brands, publishers and audience behavior, particularly among Gen Z.

What we’re looking for

• Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in editorial, content, curation, publishing, media, marketing, lifestyle, technology or a similarly fast-paced consumer environment.

• Native-level Japanese, plus business-level English for global collaboration.

• Strong editorial judgment and knowledge of the Japanese content market, consumer behavior and local trends.

• A data-informed, customer-centered approach to analyzing content performance and turning insights into action.

• Demonstrated ability to use AI-enabled tools responsibly and critically evaluate the quality and appropriateness of outputs.

• Ability to manage multiple projects independently, communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across functions and geographies.

• Experience with CMS tools, Google Workspace and Excel or similar tools.

• Experience with Canva, Figma or Adobe Photoshop; SEO-oriented content development is a plus.

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.

• プラットフォームデータ、検索行動、市場シグナルを活用し、トレンド、オーディエンスのニーズ、コンテンツ品質向上や新規ユーザー獲得の機会を特定する。

• 複数の優先事項を管理しながら、特にZ世代を中心とした日本のクリエイター、ブランド、出版社、オーディエンスの人気コンテンツや行動について、常に最新の知見を持つ。

応募要件

• 編集、コンテンツキュレーション、出版、メディア、マーケティング、ライフスタイル、テクノロジーなど急速に変化するBtoC環境で、3年以上の関連実務経験をお持ちの方。

• ネイティブレベルの日本語力と、グローバルな協業に必要なビジネスレベルの英語力をお持ちの方。

• 優れた編集判断力を持ち、日本のコンテンツ市場、消費者行動、ローカルトレンドに精通している方。

description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

As a Customer Activation Manager, you’ll partner with our largest customers to accelerate adoption, realize value, and strengthen their long-term success with Figma. As part of our Customer Success and Solutions org, you’ll lead clearly defined, short-term engagements spanning Enterprise onboarding, Governance+ activation, AI activation, and focused risk mitigation for customers whose health signals indicate potential churn or contraction. You’ll work closely with Customer Success leadership to evolve our activation strategy and build key cross-functional relationships to deliver an exceptional customer experience. You’ll use metrics, customer feedback, and direct experience to identify opportunities to improve adoption, address barriers to value, and strengthen customer health. You are an excellent communicator and project manager with a passion for customers, and we can’t wait to meet you!

This is a full-time, hybrid role based out of our Tokyo hub.

What you’ll do at Figma:

• Own and manage short-term customer activation engagements from initial scoping through successful closeout

• Lead focused risk mitigation programs for customers identified as churn or contraction risk through health scores and other signals; partner with Account Executives to understand the drivers of risk and execute targeted action plans

• Understand customer goals and barriers to adoption, and translate them into clear engagement plans with defined timelines, milestones, and measurable outcomes

• Partner closely with GTM teams to ensure smooth handoffs, alignment on customer priorities, and continuity following each engagement

• Work with Field Engineers, Design Advocates, and Product Support to execute activation and risk mitigation plans and connect customers with the right expertise and resources

• Report on engagement outcomes, adoption metrics, customer health, and customer feedback to assess impact and identify opportunities to improve programs and inform product development

• Develop content and enablement resources that support customer education, accelerate product adoption, and address common barriers to value

• Deliver tailored workshops, live and scalable training, and enablement experiences based on customer maturity, priorities, and needs

• Understand and consult on product and industry best practices to act as a trusted advisor and inspire new possibilities using Figma

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

• 3+ years of B2B SaaS experience in a customer facing role working with technical products

• Proven project management skills and experience managing multiple customer engagements concurrently

• Excellent oral and written communication skills, including the ability to navigate challenging customer conversations, Experience speaking to customers representing different personas across both function and seniority

• A consultative approach and the ability to navigate complex business needs and technical requirements. The ability to use customer feedback and data to identify barriers to adoption, prioritize actions, and measure progress toward customer outcomes

• Fluency in Japanese and English across written and verbal communication

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

• Experience using or working with Figma, or other UX/UI experience

• Experience delivering customer onboarding, adoption, or risk mitigation programs

• Experience supporting enterprise customers, or helping customers adopt AI capabilities
